faq: Which channels do you set up?
Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube and X are the usual ones. Tell us where your buyers are, and we advise if a channel is not worth your time yet.
Do I need to have logos and photos ready?
Send your logo and a few brand images if you have them. If not, we make simple profile graphics from your logo and colors. We use only images you own or have the right to use.
Can you take over an old profile?
Yes, if you are an admin of it. You add us as a manager from the platform's own settings, and we update it without ever asking for your password.
Can you set up profiles for me under your own account?
No. Profiles must belong to you, so you can always control them. We create or edit them inside your own logins, with you as owner.

desc:
Social media profile setup and optimisation gives your business a complete, consistent presence on every channel your buyers use. Ecom Swift LLC sets up or tidies each profile in your own accounts, so it looks like one brand everywhere.

## Why your profile is the first thing people judge

Before anyone reads a post, they glance at your profile. They see the photo, the name, the bio and the link, and within seconds they decide whether you look like a real business they can trust. A blank bio, a blurry logo or a link that goes nowhere makes them leave, even if your posts are good.

Profiles also act as a small search result. People look you up by name, and the words in your name, bio and category help them confirm they found the right business. A mismatch between channels, such as different handles or different logos, makes you harder to find and harder to believe.

## What is social media profile setup?

Social media profile setup is the work of preparing a business account so that every visible element is complete and correct. That includes the profile photo, cover or banner, display name, handle, bio, category, contact buttons, website link, hours and featured content. Optimisation means writing and arranging those elements so the right people understand what you offer.

## How a complete profile helps visitors act

Every visitor to a profile is deciding what to do next: follow, message, visit your website or leave. A clear bio answers what you sell and who it is for. A working link and contact button give them a way forward. Pinned or featured posts show your best work first.

None of this promises followers or sales, and results still depend on your content and audience. A finished profile does stop interested people from slipping away at the very last step.

## What a complete profile includes

- A profile photo and cover cropped correctly for each channel.
- A display name and handle that match across channels where possible.
- A bio written in your voice, with a clear line on what you offer.
- A website link, or a link in bio page that holds several links.
- Contact buttons, email and phone details where they suit the channel.
- Business category, location and opening hours.
- Story highlight covers that match your brand.
- A pinned or featured post that introduces your business.
- Saved replies and automatic greetings for common questions.
- A short sheet listing every profile link and the wording used.

## What we do

We check the current state of each account, including names, handles, images and links, and note anything that is incomplete or inconsistent. Then we prepare the images at the right sizes, write bios for each channel and enter everything in your own accounts. We switch accounts to business mode where needed and check that buttons and links work.

The Basic package covers one channel. The Standard package covers three channels with matched images, bios, a link in bio page and a check of handles. The Premium package covers five channels and adds highlight covers, pinned posts, saved replies and a handover call. You can add an extra channel, a link in bio page or a highlight cover set. We do not create fake accounts, buy followers or change a platform's rules.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Use the same logo and name style on every channel.
- Say what you sell in the first line of the bio.
- Test every link and button on a phone.
- Keep opening hours and contact details up to date.
- Pin a post that welcomes new visitors.

**Avoid:**
- Leaving default photos or empty bios.
- Using different handles on every channel.
- Packing the bio with hashtags and emojis.
- Linking to a page that does not load on mobile.
- Setting up channels you cannot keep active.

## Who this is for

This service suits a new business launching on social channels for the first time. It suits an established brand whose profiles were created at different times by different people and no longer match. It also suits an owner who wants an old, neglected account refreshed before starting to post again.

If an old profile is stuck under a former owner or a personal account, we can look at the options, but account ownership rules are set by the platform.

## What we need from you

Send your logo, brand colors, a short description of your business, your website and contact details. Tell us which channels you want and any handles you already hold. We work in your own accounts, added as an admin, editor or similar role where the platform supports it, and we never ask for passwords. Where a platform only allows login, we guide you through the step yourself.
